method.timing: shellReadyAt is page navigation to editor object present and splash removed. It is not first-input latency. Keyboard/model/visible-paragraph acceptance is a separate functional gate.
method.throttling: Renderer CPU throttling only; applied and CDP error response checked on an empty unique local page before navigating to the instrumented build. Worker/browser/host processing is not equivalently throttled.
method.scriptTiming: requestedAt observes script insertion; AMD load registers a factory. module:ready marks completed dependency/factory evaluation.
method.size: scriptBytes sums all distinct external JS files actually requested at startup, including DOCX engine and worker sources; HTML is listed separately because it contains the inline loader. Package bytes include all shipped files.
method.interpretation: Three interleaved pairs on a shared machine. A baseline sample took 33.936s; it is retained. The median difference is descriptive, not a demonstrated general opening-time improvement or a Windows/WebView2 result.
method.offline: The final functional gate was replayed on the same build after checking both CDP network response errors and navigator.onLine === false before loading deferred UI, EMF and PDF. The startup timing samples did not change; the new assertions run only in the functional gate.
